item.title: Newsletter Form
item.dc:creator: 2mandraginda.ge
item.content:encoded:
<input 
				type="email" 
				defaultValue="" 
				class="mf-input " 
				id="mf-input-email-20e43ce" 
				name="mf-email-address" 
				placeholder="${ parent.decodeEntities(`Enter your email`) } " 
				onBlur=${parent.handleChange} onFocus=${parent.handleChange} aria-invalid=${validation.errors['mf-email-address'] ? 'true' : 'false' } 
				ref=${el=> parent.activateValidation({"message":"This field is required.","emailMessage":"Please enter a valid Email address","minLength":1,"maxLength":"","type":"none","required":false,"expression":"null"}, el)}
							/>
						<${validation.ErrorMessage} 
				errors=${validation.errors} 
				name="mf-email-address" 
				as=${html``}
			/>
							<button type="submit" id="">
					${ parent.decodeEntities(`Sign Up`) } 
				</button>

item.content:encoded:
<label for="mf-input-text-43110f2b">
					${ parent.decodeEntities(`Your Name`) } 					
				</label>
			<input
				type="text"
				class="mf-input "
				id="mf-input-text-43110f2b"
				name="mf-your-name"
				placeholder="${ parent.decodeEntities(`Your name`) } "
									onInput=${parent.handleChange}
					onBlur=${parent.handleChange}
					aria-invalid=${validation.errors['mf-your-name'] ? 'true' : 'false'}
					ref=${el =>{
												parent.activateValidation({"message":"This field is required.","minLength":1,"maxLength":"","type":"none","required":false,"expression":"null"}, el)
					}}
								/>
							<${validation.ErrorMessage}
					errors=${validation.errors}
					name="mf-your-name"
					as=${html``}
					/>
							<label for="mf-input-telephone-5bbbaaf0">
					${ parent.decodeEntities(`Phone`) } 					
				</label>
			<input
				type="tel"
				class="mf-input "
				id="mf-input-telephone-5bbbaaf0" 
				name="mf-phone"
				placeholder="${ parent.decodeEntities(`Phone number`) } "
									onInput=${parent.handleChange}
					aria-invalid=${validation.errors['mf-phone'] ? 'true' : 'false'}
					ref=${el => parent.activateValidation({"message":"This field is required.","minLength":1,"maxLength":"","type":"none","required":false,"expression":"null"}, el)}
								/>
							<${validation.ErrorMessage}
					errors=${validation.errors}
					name="mf-phone"
					as=${html``}
					/>
							<label for="mf-input-email-31b3b68">
					${ parent.decodeEntities(`Email Address`) } 					
				</label>
			<input 
				type="email" 
				defaultValue="" 
				class="mf-input " 
				id="mf-input-email-31b3b68" 
				name="mf-email-address" 
				placeholder="${ parent.decodeEntities(`Your email`) } " 
				onBlur=${parent.handleChange} onFocus=${parent.handleChange} aria-invalid=${validation.errors['mf-email-address'] ? 'true' : 'false' } 
				ref=${el=> parent.activateValidation({"message":"This field is required.","emailMessage":"Please enter a valid Email address","minLength":1,"maxLength":"","type":"none","required":false,"expression":"null"}, el)}
							/>
						<${validation.ErrorMessage} 
				errors=${validation.errors} 
				name="mf-email-address" 
				as=${html``}
			/>
							<label for="mf-input-text-5fb0048d">
					${ parent.decodeEntities(`Subject`) } 					
				</label>
			<input
				type="text"
				class="mf-input "
				id="mf-input-text-5fb0048d"
				name="mf-subject"
				placeholder="${ parent.decodeEntities(`Subject`) } "
									onInput=${parent.handleChange}
					onBlur=${parent.handleChange}
					aria-invalid=${validation.errors['mf-subject'] ? 'true' : 'false'}
					ref=${el =>{
												parent.activateValidation({"message":"This field is required.","minLength":1,"maxLength":"","type":"none","required":false,"expression":"null"}, el)
					}}
								/>
							<${validation.ErrorMessage}
					errors=${validation.errors}
					name="mf-subject"
					as=${html``}
					/>
							<label for="mf-input-text-area-464de249">
					${ parent.decodeEntities(`Message`) } 					
				</label>
			<textarea id="mf-input-text-area-464de249"
				name="mf-message" 
				placeholder="${ parent.decodeEntities(`Your message`) } "
				cols="30" rows="10"
									onInput=${ parent.handleChange }
					aria-invalid=${validation.errors['mf-message'] ? 'true' : 'false'}
					ref=${ el => parent.activateValidation({"message":"This field is required.","minLength":1,"maxLength":"","type":"none","required":false,"expression":"null"}, el)}
								></textarea>
							<${validation.ErrorMessage}
					errors=${validation.errors}
					name="mf-message"
					as=${html``}
					/>
							<button type="submit" id="">
										${ parent.decodeEntities(`Send Message`) } 
				</button>

item.title: Newsletter Form
item.dc:creator: 2mandraginda.ge
item.content:encoded:
<input 
				type="email" 
				defaultValue="" 
				class="mf-input " 
				id="mf-input-email-2660a622" 
				name="mf-email-address" 
				placeholder="${ parent.decodeEntities(`Enter your email`) } " 
				onBlur=${parent.handleChange} onFocus=${parent.handleChange} aria-invalid=${validation.errors['mf-email-address'] ? 'true' : 'false' } 
				ref=${el=> parent.activateValidation({"message":"This field is required.","emailMessage":"Please enter a valid Email address","minLength":1,"maxLength":"","type":"none","required":false,"expression":"null"}, el)}
							/>
						<${validation.ErrorMessage} 
				errors=${validation.errors} 
				name="mf-email-address" 
				as=${html``}
			/>
							<button type="submit" id="">
					${ parent.decodeEntities(`Sign Up`) } 
				</button>

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: 2mandraginda.ge
item.content:encoded:
At Mand Raginda, accessible from https://mandraginda.ge/, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by Mand Raginda and how we use it.

If you have additional questions or require more information about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us.

This Privacy Policy applies only to our online activities and is valid for visitors to our website with regards to the information that they shared and/or collected in Mand Raginda. This policy is not applicable to any information collected offline or via channels other than this website. Our Privacy Policy was created with the help of the Privacy Policy Generator.

 

Information we collect

The personal information that you are asked to provide, and the reasons why you are asked to provide it, will be made clear to you at the point we ask you to provide your personal information.

The personal information that you are asked to provide, and the reasons why you are asked to provide it, will be made clear to you at the point we ask you to provide your personal information. We also ask users to submit new passwords, if applicable. We prioritize security and understand the importance of strong passwords. That’s why we don’t use weak passwords on our website we recommend that use a difficult pass generator to help safeguard your account from unauthorized access. This commitment helps protect our users' accounts and data, giving you peace of mind while using our services.When you register for an Account, we may ask for your

Personal Information We Collect from Users:

How we use your information

We use the information we collect in various ways, including to:

  • Provide, operate, and maintain our website
  • Improve, personalize, and expand our website
  • Understand and analyze how you use our website
  • Develop new products, services, features, and functionality
  • Communicate with you, either directly or through one of our partners, including for customer service, to provide you with updates and other information relating to the website, and for marketing and promotional purposes
  • Send you emails
  • Find and prevent fraud

Log Files

Mand Raginda follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. All hosting companies do this as part of hosting services’ analytics. The information collected by log files include internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks. These are not linked to any information that is personally identifiable. The purpose of the information is for analyzing trends, administering the site, tracking users’ movement on the website, and gathering demographic information.

Email Privacy Policies:

Your privacy and data security are our top priorities. We've revised our email privacy policies to give you a better experience. By allowing only real email addresses, we aim to create a safer community, and our improved encryption keeps your data secure. Fake email addresses are not allowed.

Updated Browser Policies for Enhanced Security and Privacy

Your privacy and security are our top priorities, and our updated browser policies reflect that. We now use advanced encryption to keep your data secure, limit cookie use to necessary functions only, and have enhanced our system’s ability to block harmful content. For the best security, learn how to update your browser.

Adult Content and Compliance with Pornography Laws:

To ensure a respectful and secure space, we follow pornography laws by banning adult content from our site. Our comprehensive content moderation system is in place to prevent any adult material from being published and to address violations swiftly, maintaining a family-friendly environment.

Third Party Privacy Policies

Mand Raginda’s Privacy Policy does not apply to other advertisers or websites. Thus, we are advising you to consult the respective Privacy Policies of these third-party ad servers for more detailed information. It may include their practices and instructions about how to opt-out of certain options.

You can choose to disable cookies through your individual browser options. To know more detailed information about cookie management with specific web browsers, it can be found at the browsers’ respective websites.

CCPA Privacy Rights (Do Not Sell My Personal Information)

Under the CCPA, among other rights, California consumers have the right to:

Request that a business that collects a consumer’s personal data disclose the categories and specific pieces of personal data that a business has collected about consumers.

Request that a business delete any personal data about the consumer that a business has collected.

Request that a business that sells a consumer’s personal data, not sell the consumer’s personal data.

If you make a request, we have one month to respond to you. If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please contact us.

Use of Content

Our commitment to content quality and integrity involves prohibiting Lorem Ipsum content on our website, including any Lorem Ipsum text. All content must be original, relevant, and meaningful to our audience. This ensures that our website remains a valuable and trustworthy resource for our visitors.

GDPR Data Protection Rights

We would like to make sure you are fully aware of all of your data protection rights. Every user is entitled to the following:

The right to access – You have the right to request copies of your personal data. We may charge you a small fee for this service.

The right to rectification – You have the right to request that we correct any information you believe is inaccurate. You also have the right to request that we complete the information you believe is incomplete.

The right to erasure – You have the right to request that we erase your personal data, under certain conditions.

The right to restrict processing – You have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.

The right to object to processing – You have the right to object to our processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.

The right to data portability – You have the right to request that we transfer the data that we have collected to another organization, or directly to you, under certain conditions.

If you make a request, we have one month to respond to you. If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please contact us.

Children’s Information

Another part of our priority is adding protection for children while using the internet. We encourage parents and guardians to observe, participate in, and/or monitor and guide their online activity.

Mand Raginda does not knowingly collect any Personal Identifiable Information from children under the age of 13. If you think that your child provided this kind of information on our website, we strongly encourage you to contact us immediately and we will do our best efforts to promptly remove such information from our records.

For Entity Type, we use Individual platforms.

Contact Us

A place where adrenaline, beauty and wilderness meet.

Why us?

We took off-roading to the next level.

We try to offer you a variety of content. Overcoming difficult roads, beautiful views, historical places and hiking.

High quality shooting

We strive to bring the beauty of nature to you with maximum accuracy, so that you experience the same thing we experience at that moment.

Latest model cars

The cars in the video are the latest models, and interest in new models is much higher given their capabilities.

Team professionalism

High-quality equipment and new cars would be useless without an experienced team. We try to choose the location well, record it, film it, and deliver it to you.

გასვლა 0 +

Experience and capabilities

Where the road ends, adventures begin

In this section you will see the percentage of places we have photographed across Georgia, we will try to maintain maximum accuracy.

Our partners

We create unforgettable memories in your off-road adventures.

Our team is ready to organize an off-road tour for you upon private request, where you will enjoy the beauty and feel the adrenaline.

item.title: Ford-მა ძრავის სარქვლის შესაძლო გაუმართაობის გამო 90000-ზე მეტი მანქანა გაიწვია
item.dc:creator: 2mandraginda.ge
item.content:encoded:
Ford-მა გამოაცხადა გაწვევა, რაც შეეხება 90,736 ავტომობილს, ძრავის შემავალი სარქველების პოტენციური პრობლემის გამო, რომელიც შეიძლება გატყდეს მართვის დროს და გამოიწვიოს ძრავის უკმარისობა. ეს გაწვევა, რომელიც დაადასტურა საგზაო მოძრაობის უსაფრთხოების ეროვნულმა ადმინისტრაციამ (NHTSA) შაბათს, 31 აგვისტოს, ეხება 2021-2022 წლების კონკრეტულ მოდელებს, მათ შორის Bronco, F-150, Edge, Explorer, Lincoln Nautilus და Lincoln Aviator, რომლებიც აღჭურვილია ან 2.7 ლიტრიანი ან 3.0 ლიტრიანი Nano EcoBoost ძრავა.

NHTSA-ს მიერ გამოქვეყნებული დოკუმენტების თანახმად, „ძრავის შემშვები სარქველები შეიძლება გატყდეს მართვის დროს, რამაც შეიძლება გამოიწვიოს ძრავის უკმარისობა და ძრავის სიმძლავრის დაკარგვა“. პრობლემა გამოვლინდა 2022 წლის იანვარში Ford-ის მიერ დაწყებული გამოძიების შემდეგ, რომელმაც აღმოაჩინა 22 შემთხვევა, როდესაც მიმღები სარქველები გატყდა და შევიდა ძრავის წვის პალატაში, რამაც გამოიწვია ძრავის მძიმე დაზიანება.

დაზარალდა 2021-2022 წლების მანქანები, რომლებიც აღჭურვილია 2.7 ლიტრიანი და 3.0 ლიტრიანი Nano EcoBoost ძრავებით.

Ford-ის ანალიზი ასახელებს ამ საკითხს მიმღების სარქველებს, რომლებიც აჭარბებდნენ დიზაინის სპეციფიკაციებს სიხისტეზე, რაც მათ უფრო მტვრევად და მოტეხილობისკენ მიდრეკილს ხდის. ავტომწარმოებელმა ამ პრობლემას მიაკვლია მიმწოდებლის დაფქვის პროცესებში, რომლებიც არ იყო კონტროლირებადი სპეციფიკაციების ფარგლებში. მას შემდეგ Ford-მა განაახლა შემავალი სარქვლის მასალა 2021 წლის 31 ოქტომბრის შემდეგ წარმოებული მანქანებისთვის, ამ პრობლემის გადასაჭრელად.

პრობლემის გადასაჭრელად Ford საჭიროების შემთხვევაში შეცვლის მთელ ძრავას. დილერები შეამოწმებენ დაზარალებულ მანქანებს ძრავის ციკლების კუმულაციური რაოდენობის დასადგენად. მათთვის, ვინც არ აკმაყოფილებს ძრავის ციკლის საჭირო ზღურბლს, დილერები დაიცავენ პროცედურას, რათა დააგროვონ მაღალი ბრუნვები წუთში (rpm) ძრავის ციკლებში. თუ მანქანა ვერ ჩააბარებს ამ დაგროვების ტესტს, ძრავა შეიცვლება, რაც უზრუნველყოფს დაზარალებული მოდელების უსაფრთხოებასა და საიმედოობას.

დამატებითი ინფორმაციისთვის და იმის შესამოწმებლად, შედის თუ არა თქვენი მანქანა ამ გამოწვევაში, ეწვიეთ: https://www.ford.com/support/recalls/

item.title: Off-Road Adventures in Georgia – A Thrilling Journey Through Nature’s Wonders
item.dc:creator: 2mandraginda.ge
item.content:encoded:
Off-Road Adventures in Georgia – A Thrilling Journey Through Nature’s Wonders

Off-roading is more than just a sport—it's a lot more into nature's raw beauty, a chance to conquer challenging terrains, and a way to experience the true essence of adventure. 

If you’ve been looking for the perfect off-road journey that combines adrenaline, stunning landscapes, and skilled guidance, then Georgia is the place for you. At Mand Raginda, we offer exclusive off-road tours that take you through the heart of Georgia’s rugged terrains, making sure every moment is filled with excitement, beauty, and memories that last a lifetime.

Whether you're a seasoned off-roading enthusiast or a first-time looking for an unforgettable experience, we are here to ensure you get the thrill you're seeking. 

Let’s dive into what makes our off-road adventures truly special and why you should join us on your next great adventure and how we started our journey. 

Why Choose Us for Your Off-Road Journey?

At Mand Raginda, we do more than simply take you on a tour—we deliver an experience. From the moment you join us, you’ll notice the difference in the quality of our service, the professionalism of our team, and the excellence in the equipment we provide. Here are some of the key reasons why our off-road tours stand out:

  • High-Quality Filming and Photography: Off-roading in Georgia is a visual feast, and we make sure you don't miss a single moment. With our state-of-the-art filming equipment, we capture every twist and turn, every panoramic view, and every thrilling moment of your off-road adventure. Our high-quality shots ensure that you not only experience the journey but also have incredible memories to look back on.
  • Latest Model Cars: The foundation of any great off-road experience is the vehicle you drive, and we don’t cut corners when it comes to choosing ours. Our fleet consists of the latest model off-road vehicles, designed specifically to handle the toughest terrains. Whether you're tackling steep mountain climbs or navigating through dense forests, our cars are equipped to make your journey smooth, safe, and full of adrenaline.
  • Professional Team: Behind every great adventure is a team of experts who ensure that every detail is taken care of. Our experienced guides are passionate about off-roading and are experts in navigating the diverse landscapes of Georgia. From selecting the perfect trails to ensuring the highest level of safety, our team’s professionalism guarantees that your off-road experience is second to none.

Off-Roading in Georgia – A Unique Experience

Georgia, located at the crossroads of Europe and Asia, is home to some of the most varied and scenic landscapes in the world. From the towering peaks of the Caucasus Mountains to the dense forests and historical landmarks scattered across the country, Georgia’s terrain is a paradise for off-roaders.

Our tours take you through some of Georgia’s most beautiful and rugged off-road routes. Whether you’re navigating through rocky trails, crossing fast-flowing rivers, or climbing steep hills, each journey promises to deliver a unique adventure.

The thrill of off-roading is only enhanced by the stunning vistas you’ll encounter along the way. You’ll be treated to panoramic views of lush valleys, snow-capped mountains, and ancient ruins, all while being guided by our experienced team who know the land like the back of their hand.

Evolution With Adventure

At Mandraginda, we’ve always been passionate about off-road adventures and pushing the limits. What started as a local thrill quickly grew into something much bigger. We also realized that if we wanted to reach more adrenaline junkies and outdoor lovers, we had to go globally.

We began our journey by building a website that would reflect our love for adventure and the rush that comes with off-road experiences. After doing some research, we found the best digital agency to help us create a platform that could showcase our adventures. This process not only gave us a stunning website but also helped us understand the technical side of things, which made all the difference.

One of the things that really helped us grow was picking the right hosting services. This allowed us to connect with more people and share our off-road experiences far and wide. The hosting service also helped us optimize our website for search engines, making sure our adventures showed up at the top of search results and attracted new enthusiasts.

Using premium templates, we were able to build a sleek, user-friendly booking system so that customers could easily sign up for trips. With a clean and appealing design, our website now matches the excitement and adventure we offer in real life.

When we launched our website, the response was incredible. We were able to share our passion with people from all over the world and grew our community. The decision to build our online presence has completely transformed how we operate, making it easier than ever for people to join us on these epic adventures.

A Commitment to Thrills and Innovation

At Mandraginda, we’re all about creating unforgettable adventures that give you that adrenaline rush you crave. We’re always looking for ways to enhance the thrill, whether by exploring new off-road routes or using technology to improve the experience for our guests. Our decision-making is quick and smooth, thanks to tools like a random decision-maker that helps us stay organized and make efficient choices.

We’re also big on keeping things fun and engaging for everyone. For instance, we create exciting short videos of our off-road trips that show off the wild landscapes and heart-pumping moments. These videos help potential customers see exactly what they’re signing up for. To make sure our videos are as optimized as possible, we use a duration analyzer that helps us keep them short while still packed with adrenaline.

Transparency and trust are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we make sure our privacy policy is clear and easy to understand, so our customers know exactly how their information is used when booking an adventure with us.

Explore Georgia Like Never Before with Our Expert Team

Our team is passionate about off-roading, and we are dedicated to ensuring that you experience Georgia in all its glory. We have spent years exploring every corner of this beautiful country, scouting the best off-road routes, and perfecting the art of capturing nature’s beauty through our lenses.

When you join us, you’re not just embarking on a regular off-road journey—you’re experiencing Georgia through the eyes of experts who are committed to making your trip as thrilling, safe, and memorable as possible. We take care of all the details, so you can focus on enjoying the adventure to the fullest.

Experience and Capabilities – Our Expertise in Off-Roading

The beauty of off-roading lies in the journey, but it’s the expertise of the team that makes it truly exceptional. Our team’s experience in off-roading is unmatched, and we know exactly where to take you to get the best views and the most thrilling challenges. From the famous mountain trails to hidden gems that only the most experienced off-roaders can find, we ensure that each adventure is crafted with care and precision.

In fact, we have covered nearly every significant off-road location across Georgia, which means we know the terrain inside and out. With our deep understanding of the land, we can provide you with an off-roading experience that is both exciting and safe, while showcasing the best of Georgia’s natural wonders.

Conclusion 

If you’re looking for the ultimate off-road experience, Mand Raginda is your gateway to adventure. With expert guides, the latest model vehicles, and a deep passion for the wild side of Georgia, we guarantee an off-road journey you’ll never forget. 

Whether you're joining one of our planned events or embarking on a custom tour, we promise to deliver an adrenaline-fueled experience filled with breathtaking views, expert guidance, and the thrill of off-roading like never before.

Ready to hit the trails? Contact us today to book your off-road adventure and join us for an unforgettable ride through Georgia’s rugged landscapes.

Connect Us Now!

Bağlantı hakkında

Bağlantının güncel veya resmî olduğunu bağımsız biçimde doğrulamadan kesin kabul etmeyin. Açılan sayfanın adresini kontrol edin ve yalnızca emin olduğunuz sayfalarda işlem yapın.

Jojobet Sayfasını Aç

Jojobet Üyelik ve Kayıt Süreci

Üyelik oluşturmadan önce platformun kayıt şartlarını, gizlilik politikasını ve kullanım koşullarını okuyun. Formda talep edilen bilgilerin neden istendiğini anlamadan kişisel belge veya hassas veri paylaşmayın. Kayıt sırasında yalnızca doğru ve güncel bilgileri kullanın.

Hesap güvenliği için öneriler

  • Şüpheli e-posta veya mesajlardaki bağlantılara temkinli yaklaşın.
  • Hesap kurtarma adımlarını yalnızca doğruluğundan emin olduğunuz sayfada uygulayın.

Kimlik doğrulaması veya belge talebiyle karşılaşırsanız, talebin gerekçesini ve belgelerin hangi koşullarda işleneceğini platformun ilgili politikalarından inceleyin. Bir oyun platformunu değerlendirirken yalnızca oyun çeşitliliğine ya da tanıtım ifadelerine bakmak yeterli değildir. Jojobet’te sunulan belirli oyunların adil olduğu, denetlendiği veya kazanç sağlayacağı konusunda bağımsız doğrulama olmadan garanti vermek mümkün değildir.
